name: landcube
description: LANDCU.BE generates reproducible topographic SVG and PNG artwork from the command line.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:cli
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test tests/*.test.ts src/*.test.ts src/export/*.test.ts src/frame/*.test.ts src/color/*.test.ts src/studio/*.test.ts src/studio/pages/*.test.ts src/studio/pages/*.test.tsx src/studio/control-groups/*.test.ts src/ui/*.test.ts src/ui/*.test.tsx src/ui/overlays/*.test.tsx src/system/*.test.ts src/system/*.test.tsx src/throwables/*.test.ts
scripts.test:coverage: node --import tsx --experimental-test-coverage --test tests/*.test.ts src/*.test.ts src/export/*.test.ts src/frame/*.test.ts src/color/*.test.ts src/studio/*.test.ts src/studio/pages/*.test.ts src/studio/pages/*.test.tsx src/studio/control-groups/*.test.ts src/ui/*.test.ts src/ui/*.test.tsx src/ui/overlays/*.test.tsx src/system/*.test.ts src/system/*.test.tsx src/throwables/*.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:specimens && playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:update-snapshots: npm run build && npm run build:specimens && playwright test --update-snapshots
scripts.ci:local: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run build:specimens && playwright test --reporter=list && npm run test:package
scripts.check:source: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test && tsc --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run check:source && npm run build && npm run test:package
